# 1 Chronicles Chapter 16 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 379r–379v

---

**16:1** And-they-brought the-ark of-God [ha-Elohim] and-set-it [vayyatssigu] in-the-midst of-the-tent [ha-ohel] which David had-pitched for-it. And-they-offered burnt-offerings [olot] and-peace-offerings [shelamim] before God [ha-Elohim].

**16:2** And-finished [vayekhal] David from-offering [me-ha'alot] the-burnt-offering and-the-peace-offerings, and-he-blessed the-people in-the-name of-YHWH. **16:3** And-he-distributed [vaychallaq] to-every person [ish] of-Yisra'el, from-man [me-ish] and-unto woman [ve-ad ishah], to-each a-loaf [kikkar] of-bread [lechem], and-a-portion [eshpar] [of meat], and-a-raisin-cake [ashishah].

**16:4** And-he-set [vayyitten] before the-ark of-YHWH from the-Levi'im [those] ministering [mesharetim], and-to-invoke [u-le-hazkir] and-to-thank [le-hodot] and-to-praise [u-le-hallel] YHWH, God of-Yisra'el.

**16:5** Asaf the-chief [ha-rosh], and-second [mishneh] to-him Zekharyah, Ye'i'el, and-Shemiramot, and-Yechi'el, and-Mattityah, and-Eli'av, and-Benayahu, and-Oved-Edom, and-Ye'i'el, with-instruments [bi-khlei] of-lyres [nevalim] and-with-harps [be-khinnorot]; and-Asaf with-the-cymbals [ba-metsiltayim] sounding-aloud [mashmi'a]. **16:6** And-Benayahu and-Yachazi'el the-priests with-trumpets [chatsotsrot] continually [tamid] before the-ark of-the-covenant of-God.

**16:7** Then on-that day David gave [natan] for-the-first-time [barishonah] to-thank [le-hodot] YHWH by-the-hand of-Asaf and-his-brothers:

**16:8** Give-thanks [hodu] to-YHWH, call [qir'u] on-his-name [bi-shmo]; make-known [hodi'u] among-the-peoples [ba-ammim] his-deeds [alilotav]. **16:9** Sing [shiru] to-him, sing-praises [zammeru] to-him; meditate [sichu] on-all his-wonders [nifle'otav]. **16:10** Boast [hithalelu] in-his-holy name [shem qodsho]; let-rejoice [yismach] the-heart of-those-seeking [mevaqshei] YHWH. **16:11** Seek [dirshu] YHWH and-his-strength [uzzo]; seek [baqshu] his-face [panav] continually [tamid].

**16:12** Remember [zikhru] his-wonders [nifle'otav] which he-did, his-signs [mofetav] and-the-judgments [mishpetei] of-his-mouth [pihu]. **16:13** Seed [zera] of-Yisra'el his-servant, sons of-Ya'aqov his-chosen-ones [bechirav]. **16:14** He [is] YHWH our-God; in-all the-earth [ha-arets] [are] his-judgments [mishpatav].

**16:15** Remember [zikhru] forever [le-olam] his-covenant [berito], the-word [davar] he-commanded for-a-thousand generations [le-elef dor]. **16:16** Which he-cut [karat] with-Avraham, and-his-oath [u-shevu'ato] to-Yitschaq. **16:17** And-he-established-it [vayyaamideha] to-Ya'aqov as-a-statute [le-choq], to-Yisra'el [as] an-everlasting covenant [berit olam]. **16:18** Saying: To-you I-will-give [etten] the-land of-Kena'an, the-allotment [chevel] of-your-inheritance [nachalatkhem].

**16:19** When-you-were [bi-hyotkhem] few [metei] in-number [mispar], a-little [ki-me'at] and-sojourners [garim] in-it, **16:20** and-they-went from-nation [mi-goy] to nation [el goy], and-from [one] kingdom to another people [am acher]. **16:21** He-did-not allow [lo hini'ach] any-man [ish] to-oppress-them [le-oshqam], and-he-rebuked [vayyokhach] kings [melakhim] on-their-account. **16:22** Do-not touch [al-tigg'u] my-anointed-ones [bi-mshichay], and-to-my-prophets [ve-li-nvi'ay] do-no harm [al-tarei'u].

**16:23** Sing [shiru] to-YHWH, all the-earth [kol ha-arets]; proclaim [basseru] from-day to-day his-salvation [yeshu'ato]. **16:24** Declare [sapperu] among-the-nations [ba-goyim] his-glory [kevodo], among-all the-peoples [ammim] his-wonders [nifle'otav].

**16:25** For great [gadol] [is] YHWH and-greatly to-be-praised [mehullal me'od]; and-fearful [nora] [is] he above-all gods [elohim]. **16:26** For all the-gods [elohei] of-the-peoples [ha-ammim] [are] idols [elilim], and-YHWH made [asah] the-heavens [shamayim]. **16:27** Splendor [hod] and-majesty [hadar] [are] before-him [le-fanav]; strength [oz] and-joy [chedvah] [are] in-his-place [bi-mqomo].

**16:28** Ascribe [havu] to-YHWH, O-families [mishpechot] of-peoples [ammim], ascribe to-YHWH glory [kavod] and-strength [oz]. **16:29** Ascribe to-YHWH the-glory of-his-name [kevod shemo]; bring [se'u] an-offering [minchah] and-come before-him [le-fanav]. Worship [hishtachavu] YHWH in-the-splendor [be-hadrat] of-holiness [qodesh]. **16:30** Tremble [chilu] before-him, all the-earth [kol ha-arets]; indeed [af], the-world [tevel] is-established [tikkon]; it-shall-not be-shaken [timmot].

**16:31** Let-rejoice [yismechu] the-heavens and-let-be-glad [tagel] the-earth, and-let-them-say [ve-yomru] among-the-nations: YHWH reigns [malakh]! **16:32** Let-thunder [yir'am] the-sea and-its-fullness [u-melo'o]; let-exult [ya'alots] the-field [ha-sadeh] and-all that [is] in-it. **16:33** Then shall-sing-for-joy [yeranenu] the-trees [atsei] of-the-forest [ha-ya'ar] before YHWH, for he-comes [va] to-judge [lishpot] the-earth [ha-arets].

**16:34** Give-thanks [hodu] to-YHWH for [he is] good [tov], for forever [le-olam] [endures] his-steadfast-love [chasdo]. **16:35** And-say [ve-imru]: Save-us [hoshi'enu], O-God of-our-salvation [elohei yish'enu]; and-gather-us [ve-qabbetsenu] and-deliver-us [ve-hatssilenu] from the-nations [min ha-goyim], to-give-thanks [le-hodot] to-your-holy name [le-shem qodshekha], to-glory [le-hishtabbe'ach] in-your-praise [bi-tehillatekha].

**16:36** Blessed [barukh] [be] YHWH, God of-Yisra'el, from the-everlasting [min ha-olam] and-unto the-everlasting [ve-ad ha-olam]. And-said all the-people: Amen! And-praise [hallel] to-YHWH.

**16:37** And-he-left [vayyaazov] there before the-ark of-the-covenant of-YHWH, Asaf and-his-brothers, to-minister [le-sharet] before the-ark continually [tamid], as-a-matter [le-devar] of-each day [yom] in-its-day [be-yomo]. **16:38** And-Oved-Edom and-their-brothers — sixty-eight — and-Oved-Edom son of-Yedutun, and-Chosah, as-gatekeepers [le-sho'arim].

**16:39** And-Tsadoq the-priest and-his-brothers the-priests before the-Tabernacle [mishkan] of-YHWH at-the-high-place [ba-bamah] which [was] in-Giv'on, **16:40** to-offer burnt-offerings to-YHWH upon the-altar of-burnt-offering continually [tamid], in-the-morning and-in-the-evening, and-for-all that-is-written [ha-kathuv] in-the-Torah [be-torat] of-YHWH which he-commanded upon Yisra'el.

**16:41** And-with-them Heyman and-Yedutun and-the-rest [she'ar] of-the-chosen [ha-berurim], who were-designated [niqevu] by-names, to-give-thanks to-YHWH, for forever [le-olam] [endures] his-steadfast-love [chasdo]. **16:42** And-with-them — Heyman and-Yedutun — trumpets [chatsotsrot] and-cymbals [metsiltayim] for-sounding-aloud, and-instruments [kelei] of-the-song [shir] of-God. And-the-sons of-Yedutun [were] at-the-gate [la-sha'ar].

**16:43** And-went all the-people, each to-his-house, and-turned [vayyissov] David to-bless his-house [beito].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7 — barishonah:** "For the first time" — the Chronicler presents this psalm as the inaugural act of Israelite liturgical worship. This is a founding moment: David commissions Asaph to lead a permanent ministry of thanksgiving.

**v.8-22 — Psalm 105:1-15:** The first section of David's psalm corresponds closely to Psalm 105:1-15. The Chronicler places this already-existing psalm in David's mouth as the first liturgical act at the newly installed ark.

**v.23-33 — Psalm 96:1-13:** The second section draws from Psalm 96, a "new song" psalm. The Chronicler's version has one key variation in v.27: where Psalm 96:6 reads "strength and beauty [tif'eret] are in his sanctuary [be-miqdosho]," the Chronicler reads "strength and joy [chedvah] are in his place [bi-mqomo]" — because the temple does not yet exist.

**v.34-36 — Psalm 106:1, 47-48:** The final section draws the opening and closing of Psalm 106. Verse 35 — "save us...gather us from the nations" — is a post-exilic prayer placed in David's pre-exilic mouth, revealing the Chronicler's own historical situation.

**v.39 — ba-bamah:** "At the high place" — the Chronicler acknowledges that the Gibeon altar functioned as a legitimate worship site before the temple. This dual worship arrangement (ark in Jerusalem, altar in Gibeon) is unique to Chronicles.

*— EMET*
